A '''skirmish''' occurred on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] when [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and Skywalker's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] allied themselves with a band of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] to defend a [[Akira/Legends|farming settlement]] from [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|pirates]] led by [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]]. The Jedi and bounty hunters' efforts prevailed over the pirate band's, though with some loss of life.<ref name="BH">{{TCW|Bounty Hunters (episode)}}</ref>
